# Fostier Index

> Fostier Index is a Hong Kong agency that rebuilds websites for established firms so Google ranks them and AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity cite them. It works in English and Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong).

Services (prices in Hong Kong dollars, fixed and agreed before work starts):

- AEO/GEO Diagnostic: from HK$1,500. How your site compares with two local competitors, in Google and in AI search. Credited toward your rebuild.
- SEO/GEO website rebuild: from HK$12,000. New site architecture, schema markup and answer-first pages, in the languages your clients search in.
- Monthly authority and GEO retainer: from HK$6,000 a month. Directory listings, press and expert content that give AI tools reasons to cite you. Three-month minimum.

Contact: contact@fostierindex.com. Consultation requests: https://fostierindex.com/#consult

## Pages

- [Home](https://fostierindex.com/): services, prices and FAQ
- [SEO, AEO and GEO for Hong Kong firms](https://fostierindex.com/aeo-guide/): What SEO, AEO and GEO mean, how AI answers pick their sources, and what a Hong Kong firm should fix on and off its website to be cited.
